meta.title: Remove unnecessary Maven plugins from azure-openrewrite pom.xml
meta.body_summary: Remove unnecessary Maven plugins from azure-openrewrite/pom.xml to speed up builds, with iterative restorations after maintainer feedback.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot initially removed essential plugins and x-version-update comments; after multiple maintainer corrections, only maven-pmd-plugin was removed, and the PR was eventually merged after ~785h with many review rounds.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 3701 changed lines this is a large change by absolute volume, but the bulk comes from merge commits with unrelated version bumps. The core pom.xml change is small. As a build optimization PR, it merged after many review rounds and iterative corrections.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainers flagged that maven-checkstyle-plugin, spotbugs-maven-plugin, and spotless-maven-plugin were necessary, and that x-version-update comments were important metadata; Copilot had erroneously removed them.
review_details.performance_claim: Improves build performance by eliminating unnecessary plugin executions.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot lacked understanding of project-specific Maven plugin requirements and metadata conventions, resulting in removal of essential plugins and x-version-update comments. Required iterative maintainer guidance to restore correct configuration.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainers reviewed the pom.xml diff and identified missing essential plugins and removed metadata comments.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or numerical performance claim; PR claims build performance improvement without evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainers requested restoration of spotless, checkstyle, spotbugs plugins and x-version-update comments; Copilot added them back in subsequent commits.

core_change_summary.description: Primarily modifies sdk/tools/azure-openrewrite/pom.xml to remove maven-pmd-plugin while restoring other plugins and metadata comments after maintainer feedback. Temporary pom.xml.backup was created and deleted. Many unrelated merge commits introduced changes across the repository.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Many files from merge commits are unrelated to performance; total file count inflated by version bumps across the repo.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and tentative changes, including backup pom.xml.backup.
First attempt: removed maven-pmd-plugin, maven-checkstyle-plugin, spotbugs-maven-plugin, spotless-maven-plugin.
jairmyree instructed to keep azure-openrewrite-compiler-maven-plugin; Copilot confirmed as already kept.
jairmyree requested removal of pom.xml.backup; done.
jairmyree requested restoration of spotless plugin; added back.
jairmyree requested restoration of checkstyle and spotbugs plugins; restored later with original configurations.
Multiple merge commits brought in main branch changes.
Concern about x-version-update comment removal; Copilot restored one missing comment.
Final approval after all corrections; merged after ~785 hours.

review_signals.summary: Instructed Copilot not to remove azure-openrewrite-compiler-maven-plugin, which was already kept.
Spotless plugin is necessary; add it back.
Checkstyle and spotbugs plugins are essential; restore them.
review_signals.action_taken: Both plugins restored with original config.

review_signals.summary: x-version-update comment on azure-core dependency must be restored.
review_signals.action_taken: Comment restored inline with version element.

review_signals.summary: Asked if removal of Checkstyle and Spotbugs was intentional, noting build dependency on eng/code-quality-reports.
Bot posted PR overview summarizing plugin removals; no blocking comments.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial plugin removals.
jairmyree immediately warned about essential compiler plugin.
Multiple maintainer instructions to restore missing plugins and metadata.
Copilot iteratively added back spotless, checkstyle, spotbugs, and x-version-update comment.
After many review rounds and final approvals, PR merged after ~785 hours.
